case_title: Manoj Kumar Sharma & Ors. v. State of Chhattisgarh & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, a Flying Officer, married the victim. The victim committed suicide at her matrimonial home. The police conducted an inquiry under Section 174 of the Code, which concluded there was no foul play. A Court of Inquiry was also convened but closed without finding any wrongdoing. Five years later, the brother of the deceased filed a fresh FIR based on anonymous letters, alleging pre-planned murder. The police investigation was reopened, but the High Court ordered continuation of the investigation. The Supreme Court found the FIR to be based on vague allegations and delayed, leading to the quashing of the FIR and dropping of the criminal proceedings against the accused.
